response.sql: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(1.0 * derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS invoice_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS avg_invoice_ratio FROM invoice_averages) SELECT AVG(i.avg_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(i.invoice_ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(i.invoice_ratio - o.avg_invoice_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio FROM invoice_averages AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.invoice_ratio > o.avg_invoice_ratio;
